svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Serverless web API on AWS
svg.desc: Serverless web API on AWS. 8 components in 2 groups. Connections: Users to Amazon CloudFront (HTTPS); Users to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Amazon CloudFront to Web app bucket (static files); Amazon CloudFront to Amazon API Gateway (/api/*); Amazon Cognito to Amazon API Gateway (JWT authorizer); Amazon API Gateway to Orders function; Orders function to Orders table; Orders function to Receipts bucket.

text.tspan: Single-page app on CloudFront, REST API on API Gateway and Lambda, Cognito sign-in
